questions.story: Bangladeshi cricket team in South Africa in 2026–27
questions.question: Which country's cricket team saw their wicketkeeper Litton Das break the world record for most dismissals in a single Test match innings?
questions.explanation: Bangladeshi keeper Litton Das claimed eight dismissals in an innings against South Africa in Johannesburg to secure the world record.
questions.context: Bangladeshi cricket team in South Africa in 2026–27: In Test cricket, Bangladeshi wicketkeeper Litton Das sets a world record for the most dismissals in a single Test innings, recording six catches and two stumpings against South Africa in Johannesburg.

questions.question: Which historic spacecraft became the very first man-made object to reach a distance of one light-day away from Earth?
questions.explanation: Launched back in 1977, NASA's Voyager 1 probe has made history by travelling one light-day away from our planet.
questions.context: NASA's space probe Voyager 1 reaches the distance of one light-day from Earth, being the first man-made object to reach that distance, after it launched in 1977.

questions.story: Russo-Ukrainian War > Crimea attacks > 2026 Crimean Bridge explosions
questions.question: Traffic was completely halted on the Crimean Bridge after it was targeted for the third time in four days by forces from which country?
questions.explanation: Ukrainian strikes on the Crimean Bridge led Russian officials to shut down all transport across the structure.
questions.context: Russo-Ukrainian War > Crimea attacks > 2026 Crimean Bridge explosions: The Crimean Bridge is struck by Ukrainian forces for the third time in four days, prompting Russian authorities to close the bridge to all traffic.

questions.question: Which artist set a new auction record after their 1890 painting Blossoming Chestnut Trees sold for over $190 million at Sotheby's?
questions.explanation: Vincent van Gogh's masterpiece set a fresh record for the artist when it fetched $190.4 million at an auction in New York City.
questions.context: Vincent van Gogh's 1890 painting Blossoming Chestnut Trees sells for US$190.4 million at Sotheby's in New York City, United States, setting a new auction record for Van Gogh and surpassing the $117.2 million paid for Orchard with Cypresses (1888) in 2022.

questions.question: The former ancestral home of Nobel Peace Prize laureate Muhammad Yunus was set on fire in which nation?
questions.explanation: Arsonists targeted the ancestral property belonging to former chief adviser Muhammad Yunus in Bangladesh.
questions.context: Arsonists set fire to the ancestral home of former chief adviser Muhammad Yunus in Panchlaish, Chattogram, Bangladesh.
